sn22.116:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn22.116:1.4: kittāvatā nu kho bhante, dhammakathiko hoti?
sn22.116:1.5: kittāvatā dhammānudhammapaṭipanno hoti? kittāvatā diṭṭhadhammanibbānappatto hotī”ti?
sn22.116:1.6: rūpassa ce bhikkhu, nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya dhammaṃ deseti, “dhammakathiko bhikkhū”ti alaṃ vacanāya.
sn22.116:1.7: rūpassa ce bhikkhu nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti, “dhammānudhammapaṭipanno bhikkhū”ti alaṃ vacanāya.
sn22.116:1.8: rūpassa ce bhikkhu nibbidā virāgā nirodhā anupādā vimutto hoti, “diṭṭhadhammanibbānappatto bhikkhū”ti alaṃ vacanāya.
